description:
Look up a company or a person and get a structured card back, plus the ranked sources behind it. A company card carries the profile, identifiers, financial and stock metrics, key people and recent announcements; a person card carries the current position, career history and recent activity. Name two companies in one query and you get a card for each, same fields, ready to compare. Set `entities.enable` to false for a plain ranked list instead.

USE FOR **any** question about a company or the people in one, including the numbers: revenue, net income, gross profit by quarter and year, share price and 52-week range, funding rounds and who led them, headcount and web traffic, key people and their titles, career history, recent announcements. Also "what does this company do", due diligence, and how two of them compare.

The card already holds those figures, so a question like "what was their revenue last quarter" is one call here. Reaching for `search` means reading a dozen pages for numbers this returns directly, and far more context for the same facts.

NOT FOR breaking coverage of an event — use `news_search`, which returns articles and storylines. NOT FOR general web pages — use `search`.

Examples: "NVIDIA company overview", "Lisa Su AMD CEO", "compare Stripe and Adyen payment processing", "semiconductor supply chain outlook".

keywords: company, business, due diligence, competitor, executive, CEO, founder, funding, valuation, revenue, earnings, stock, profile, who is, what does company do, compare companies

count.description: Number of results to return (1-100). Default 5.

end_time.description: Upper bound for the time window, ISO 8601.

entities.description: The company and person cards. On by default — omit to use the server default, or disable for a plain ranked list. The domain, time and language filters apply to the ranked results only, never to the cards.

exclude_domains.description: Drop results from these domains. Max 1200, each ≤60 chars.

full_content.description: Return the cleaned full page body per result. Heavier than `highlight` — use only when the snippet isn't enough. Omit to use the server default (off).

max_tokens.description: Max tokens of full content per result (100-100000).

highlight.description: Return a ranked highlighted snippet per result. Omit to use the server default.

include_domains.description: Only return results from these domains (e.g. 'arxiv.org'). Max 1200, each ≤60 chars.

language.description: Languages to filter results by, as ISO 639-1 codes. Empty = no filter.

start_time.description: Lower bound for the time window, ISO 8601 (e.g. '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z').

time_basis.description: Which timestamp the time window filters against: page `published` date, last `crawled` date, or `auto`. Default auto.

time_range.description: Relative time window (e.g. `week`, `month`). Mutually exclusive with `start_time`/`end_time` — if both are given, the absolute range wins.

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds (1-60). Defaults to 30s if unset.

name: business_search
title: Business Search
